input.complaints: Sudden high fever for 2 days with severe pain and swelling in both wrists, ankles and small joints of the hands, and a pink rash on the trunk. Joint pain is worse in the morning.
input.history: No known liver or kidney disease. No other illnesses.
input.findings: Temp 39.0 C, BP 118/76, pulse 96/min. No bleeding, no vomiting, passing urine normally. Several people in her village have had a similar illness in the past two weeks. No blood tests done yet.
